title: Proprietary Teams Bridge
description: Mod to bridge Priopetary Teams mod to FOSS alteanatives
body:
# Proprietary Teams Bridge

A mod to bridge the Proprietary Teams mod FTB Teams to NoreTeams using mixins.

Any addon to FTB Teams will now magically work with Nore Teams.

Please note this mod still requires the offending mod.

Tested with NeoVitaeTeams a NeoVitae (blood magic) addon to FTB teams to use Soul network points per team.
